resources.string: Wait a moment where you can see the sky.\nYour run starts as soon as GPS is found.
You\'ll be marked ready as soon as GPS is found.
Runs measure distance and route with GPS. Please run with a phone that has GPS.
In location settings, set the mode to “High accuracy” or “GPS”.
A mock location app is on
Turn off the mock location app in developer options to use real GPS.
GPS doesn\'t work indoors or underground. Step outside where you can see the sky.
Move a little away from tall buildings or trees. Your run starts once accuracy is within %1$dm.
The first fix can take a few minutes
Phones without a SIM, or that haven\'t used GPS in a while, take longer the first time. Connect to Wi-Fi and wait outside.
Allow precise location to run together. Turn on “Use precise location” in Settings › Permissions › Location.
